# Timeline: `jl-timeline`

What happened, in order, along a vertical line with markers coloured by tone.

- Class `JlTimeline`, a molecule: `import { JlTimeline } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/timeline

A timeline tells what happened, in order: the activity of a project, the steps of a deployment, the
history of an order. Each event has a title, and optionally a time, a description and a tone that colours its
marker. An icon draws the marker as a circle; without one it is a dot. The times stand in a column between the
markers and the titles, each on its title's line, so however wide the timeline, a time stays with its event.

Give the events newest first or oldest first, as the page reads best: the timeline keeps the order it is given.
compact tightens it for a side panel.

## Use

```ts
import { JlTimeline } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlTimeline items={[{"title":"Deployed to production","time":"14:32","tone":"ok","icon":"rocket"},{"title":"Checks passed","time":"14:27","description":"312 tests, lint and types.","tone":"ok"},{"title":"Branch created","time":"09:41"}]} />
```

```html
<jl-timeline items='[{"title":"Deployed to production","time":"14:32","tone":"ok","icon":"rocket"},{"title":"Checks passed","time":"14:27","description":"312 tests, lint and types.","tone":"ok"},{"title":"Branch created","time":"09:41"}]'></jl-timeline>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `items` (attribute `items`): `TimelineItem[]`, default `[]`. The events, in the order shown: title, and optionally time, description, tone (neutral, accent, ok, warn, danger, info) and icon.
- `compact` (attribute `compact`): `boolean`, default `false`. Smaller markers and less space between events.
- `label` (attribute `label`): `string`, default `''`. The name of the list for screen readers.

## Styling

- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The list of events.

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### Deployment

Icons in circles, coloured by tone.

```html
<div class="narrow">
  <jl-timeline label="Deployment of v2.4.0" items='[
    {"title":"Deployed to production","time":"14:32","description":"v2.4.0 is live for every workspace.","tone":"ok","icon":"rocket"},
    {"title":"Checks passed","time":"14:27","description":"312 tests, lint and types.","tone":"ok","icon":"circle-check"},
    {"title":"Merged feat/offline-mode","time":"14:18","description":"Ada merged 14 commits into main.","tone":"accent","icon":"git-merge"},
    {"title":"Review requested","time":"11:05","description":"Ben and Hana were asked to review.","icon":"message"},
    {"title":"Branch created","time":"09:41","icon":"git-branch"}
  ]'></jl-timeline>
</div>
```

### Order history

Dots: the tone says how it went.

```html
<div class="narrow">
  <jl-timeline label="Order 10482" items='[
    {"title":"Delivered","time":"Mar 6","tone":"ok"},
    {"title":"Delivery attempt failed","time":"Mar 5","description":"Nobody was home; a second attempt is planned.","tone":"warn"},
    {"title":"Shipped","time":"Mar 3","description":"Parcel 3S-88213 left the warehouse."},
    {"title":"Payment received","time":"Mar 2","tone":"info"},
    {"title":"Order placed","time":"Mar 2"}
  ]'></jl-timeline>
</div>
```

### Compact

Compact, for a side panel.

```html
<div style="max-width: 300px">
  <jl-timeline compact label="Activity" items='[
    {"title":"Hana commented","time":"2m","icon":"message","tone":"accent"},
    {"title":"Build failed on fix/login","time":"18m","icon":"circle-x","tone":"danger"},
    {"title":"Ben uploaded 3 files","time":"1h","icon":"upload"},
    {"title":"Chen joined the project","time":"3h","icon":"user","tone":"ok"}
  ]'></jl-timeline>
</div>
```
